scientific.integrity: The determinant identity is proved entrywise. The impossibility theorem uses two strictly positive matrices with identical marginals. The dynamic extension follows from linearity of exponential averaging and marginalization.
limitations: The finding isolates second-moment compression and does not assert failure of the full clipped optimizer.
It is a worst-case coordinatewise fidelity result.
Positive second-moment floors can impose problem-dependent finite distortion bounds.
The dynamic comparison uses the no-first-moment form relevant to Adafactor's core factored estimator.

title: Exact two-by-two determinant law and marginal indistinguishability for Adafactor
